lead.headline: Big Stric leads by 14.06. Chase is coming.
lead.dek: Big Stric Energy was a 66.6% favorite at 8:48 AM. It now leads deeboliciouskins 115.14 to 101.08 with one player left, and the live board makes it a 20% team, because Ja’Marr Chase hasn’t kicked off.
lead.pull: Big Stric Energy 115.14. deeboliciouskins 101.08. Guess which one is sweating.
body: At 8:48 AM, Big Stric Energy sat on 0.0 and the live board had it a 66.6% favorite anyway. Five hours later Big Stric leads 115.14 to 101.08, and it is 20% to win. That’s the biggest swing of the morning, and it ran directly against the scoreboard.

Here’s how a team leads and loses at the same time: Big Stric Energy spent its whole lineup before lunch. Nico Collins went for 24.4 against a 15.44 projection, Josh Allen 23.34, Justin Jefferson 16.4, Rashee Rice 13.2. Then the potholes: Jalen Coker 0.3 in the flex against 13.19, Jordan Love 11.8 against 17.5, the Jaguars D/ST 3.0. One Big Stric player is left, Ashton Jeanty, at 2.3 and live. Live projection: 124.49.

The franchise I cover still has three bullets. Ja’Marr Chase (19.89) hasn’t played yet; he goes at 5:20 PM. George Pickens (1.6) and Jason Myers (1.0) are live in the late window. They already had Patrick Mahomes going nuclear, 35.42 against a 20.04 projection, plus Jayden Daniels’ 22.76 from Thursday and 12.0 from the Chiefs D/ST. Live projection: 138.43. The math is simple: Chase, Pickens and Myers have to outscore Jeanty by more than 14.06.

And yes, deeboliciouskins is doing it a man down. D’Andre Swift is still in the RB slot on bye at 0.0. Tony Pollard, the bench answer, played at 10:00 AM and put 23.9 on the bench. DJ Moore (19.4) and the Vikings D/ST (21.0) joined him there. The Swift slot isn’t a busted lineup yet; it can still be filled from the wire, and Justice Hill (7.23), unrostered in R.A.T.S. and trending, plays Monday at 5:15 PM. Free points are free points.

Pick: deeboliciouskins, at 80%. Big Stric Energy has done everything a 2-7 team can do, and it might not matter. This is Chase against Jeanty now, and Chase has the bigger projection and the later kickoff. Big Stric fans, find a hobby until 5:20 PM.

quick_hits.headline: Emmett Johnson: 35.1. The 7:56 AM add.
quick_hits.body: The Saturday pickup this desk graded A this morning put up 35.1 against a 16.74 projection, and it hasn’t been enough. Yet. Bad things man bad things leads 151.32 to 131.78 behind Chuba Hubbard’s 34.2 and James Cook III’s 21.7. The live board moved from 51.8% at 8:48 AM to 57.6% for Bad things; Maye is at 42.4%, 173.36 to 176.91 projected.

quick_hits.headline: Three left on each side, 3.55 apart
quick_hits.body: Maye I touch your TDs? has Brock Purdy (6.36, live), Matt Gay (4.0, live) and Monday’s Zay Flowers (16.24). Bad things man bad things has Trey McBride (3.3, live), the Rams D/ST (8.0, live) and Evan McPherson (7.43) at 5:20 PM. The projections are 3.55 apart. Drake Maye finished with 3.02. Purdy is the only quarterback this franchise has left.

quick_hits.headline: Down 37.36, Poochinski has eight left
quick_hits.body: Jahmyr Gibbs finished at 44.2 and Poochinski still trails Cherry Blossom 101.8 to 64.44. But Poochinski has eight starters still to go, led by CeeDee Lamb (19.98, live) and Dak Prescott (18.39, live), with Aaron Rodgers and Chase Brown at 5:20 PM. Cherry Blossom has five left. The live board moved Poochinski from 26.8% to 35.2%.

quick_hits.headline: Cherry Blossom’s Jacksonville stack cashed
quick_hits.body: Parker Washington (28.2) and Trevor Lawrence (27.78) both blew through their projections, and Jared Goff added 22.42. Christian McCaffrey (0.6) and Brock Bowers (3.8) are live; Jaylen Warren, Tee Higgins and the Ravens D/ST are still to come. Projection: 176.08 to 164.69, 64.8%.

quick_hits.headline: The Finest: 141.7, with Burrow still to play
quick_hits.body: Isaiah Likely 27.7, Cam Skattebo 27.2, Bhayshul Tuten 20.3, Stefon Diggs 20.3. Santa Clara’s Finest leads AB81 141.7 to 27.64 and is 100% to win, with Joe Burrow (22.43) still to play. AB81’s best scorer is its kicker, Cam Little, at 19.0.

quick_hits.headline: The benches had a better morning
quick_hits.body: deeboliciouskins: Pollard 23.9, Vikings D/ST 21.0, DJ Moore 19.4 on the bench. Bad things man bad things: Kirk Cousins 16.38 on the bench while Tyler Shough started for 10.98, plus Josh Downs 15.3. Poochinski: Quinshon Judkins 16.1 on the bench. None of it has cost a game. Yet.

w10-m1.blurb: Big Stric Energy 115.14, deeboliciouskins 101.08. Big Stric has only Ashton Jeanty (2.3, live) left; deeboliciouskins has Ja’Marr Chase at 5:20 PM plus Pickens and Myers live. Live projection 138.43 to 124.49, 80% deeboliciouskins.

w10-m2.blurb: Bad things man bad things leads 151.32 to 131.78. Three left each: Purdy, Gay and Monday’s Flowers for Maye; McBride, the Rams D/ST and McPherson for Bad things. Projected 176.91 to 173.36, 57.6% Bad things.

w10-r2-s0.blurb: Poochinski picked up Aaron Rodgers at 9:28 AM, dropped Chris Godwin Jr. and put Rodgers in for the bye-week Caleb Williams. Rodgers (17.68) goes at 5:20 PM.

w10-r2-s8.blurb: Poochinski made the flex call: Jadarian Price (8.97) in for Luther Burden III. Price has 0.9 and is live; Quinshon Judkins went for 16.1 on the bench.

w10-r7-s2.headline: Corum in for Walker, and live
w10-r7-s2.blurb: The Finest’s RB call: Blake Corum in, Kenneth Walker III out. Corum has 4.9 and is live. At 100%, it’s a footnote.
